name: What is the process for installing a new walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing a new walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and assess your current bathroom space. We then design the layout, select materials, and provide a detailed quote. Once approved, existing fixtures are removed, and any necessary plumbing or structural modifications are made. This is followed by waterproofing, tiling, installing the shower pan, glass enclosures, and fixtures. Finally, the area is cleaned, and a final walkthrough ensures your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves consultation, design, demolition, plumbing/structural work, waterproofing, tiling, fixture installation, and a final walkthrough. We handle every step.
